subject: Week start wrong in report builder

messages.name: Gringotts Financial admin
messages.body: Our locale is set to Monday but the report date picker starts weeks on Sunday. Are our weekly numbers wrong?

messages.name: Nora (Support Tier 2)
messages.body: That's BUG-2310-03 (Low, open). It is cosmetic: the picker always starts on Sunday, but the report data is correct.
